node.title: KoalaBear m2 r2 residual dihedral star-graph rigidity
node.closure: regular D3/D6 coset incidence, full-V4 orientation exchange, and exact complete-source graph reconstruction
node.statement: In every surviving full-V4 n=3 or n=6 dihedral profile, the second endpoint lift exchanges the two cross-edge orientations over each Z value. The complete source-star graph is therefore two disjoint K_(2,2,2) graphs for n=3 or the two-point blow-up of C_6 for n=6. All 24 star weights are one, the defect is zero, and every source row has degree four. This proves rigidity, not existence or deletion of either profile.
